independent_reference.source: Order-existence criterion |m*lambda/d| <= 1 (Palmer & Loewen handbook, ch. 2): m = +-2 sits exactly at |sin| = 1 — the +-90 deg grazing cutoff, excluded from the propagating-order count.

Grating equation sin(theta_m) = m*lambda/d at normal incidence (Palmer & Loewen, Diffraction Grating Handbook, Newport, ch. 2): 1000 lines/mm at 500 nm gives sin(theta_1) = 0.5 => theta_1 = 30.0 deg exactly (spec section 4 golden D).

Zeroth (specular) order theta_0 = 0 exactly at normal incidence; mirror symmetry theta_{-m} = -theta_m asserted across the table in packages/fdtd-optics/tests/test_golden_tables.py. Carries the propagating-order count 3 (m = 0, +-1).

Grating equation sin(theta_m) = m*lambda/d at normal incidence (Palmer & Loewen, Diffraction Grating Handbook, Newport, ch. 2): 1000 lines/mm at 500 nm gives sin(theta_1) = 0.5 => theta_1 = 30.0 deg exactly (spec section 4 golden D).
